sn47.50:1.3: The taint of sensuality, the taint of existence, the taint of ignorance.
sn47.50:1.5: The four establishments of mindfulness are to be developed for the full understanding of these three taints.
sn47.50:2.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body …
sn47.50:2.5: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.50:2.6: “These four establishments of mindfulness, bhikkhus, are to be developed for the full understanding of these three taints.”
